Subject: A hulking white-furred bipedal ape monster with broad shoulders, blue face, long arms and large feet. Genuine transparent background. One complete centered subject with a one-pixel clear margin. Full body for creatures, full object for equipment. No scenery or extra objects beyond the stated subject.
